capabilities: Draft articles in a managed articles folder with missing-note and missing-image checks
Preview article layout at phone width and crop screenshots for Dzen
Export numbered illustration copies plus Markdown and self-contained Base64 HTML
Copy title, text, and captions to the clipboard for pasting into a Dzen draft
Mark transferred article versions to compare against later edits
disambiguation: Not a website or Obsidian Publish publisher; it prepares drafts for the Dzen platform and local file exports.
extras: Free for personal and commercial use; source code is private but available to Obsidian for review. A separate Russian-language guide is linked. Requires desktop Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tools for assembling articles with cropped illustrations and transferring them to Dzen drafts.

relations.evidence: Use the copy buttons to paste the title, text and captions into your Dzen draft.

requires.name: Dzen (in the browser, for creating the draft)

summary: Article drafting workspace that prepares text and illustrations for the Dzen platform and exports Markdown or self-contained HTML.
